name: agent-orchestration-worker
description: The real receiver graph/ was always a prototype for — a Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object that imports graph/'s pure logic directly and adds the I/O (GitHub API calls, D1 log, the watchdog alarm). Not deployed anywhere; see wrangler.toml's header comment. coordinate/ is the core dispatch logic as a dependency-injected pure function; index.ts and issue-coordinator.ts are the thin Worker/DO wiring around it — all three tested with plain vitest against fakes (no Miniflare/@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers needed, deliberately — see README.md).
